evidence.title: Trump says he will observe 9/11 anniversary at the Pentagon

evidence.title: Trump confirms Pentagon plans for 25th anniversary of 9/11 attacks, disputes report on Ground Zero absence

occurrences.checkable_against: White House travel schedule and official attendance records for the three 9/11 memorial sites
occurrences.quote_span: "The vice president is still traveling to NYC, and all three sites will be represented with administration officials in attendance," a White House official said, referring to the three Sept. 11 attack sites in Manhattan, at the Pentagon and near Shanksville, Pennsylvania, where United Airlines Flight 93 crashed.
occurrences.speaker: White House official
occurrences.subject: President Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Donald Trump's public statements and contemporaneous records concerning September 11, 2001
occurrences.quote_span: President Trump has spoken about his own experiences watching the horrific events of September 11, 2001.
occurrences.speaker: Anna Kelly
occurrences.subject: President Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: White House schedule and official 25th-anniversary 9/11 ceremony program
occurrences.quote_span: President Donald Trump said Friday he's going to be at the Pentagon to mark the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 terrorist attacks.
occurrences.speaker: Donald Trump
occurrences.subject: President Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: The New York Times report and official Ground Zero ceremony attendance and speaking records
occurrences.quote_span: On Thursday, The New York Times reported that Trump was not planning to attend the ceremony at Ground Zero, where the Twin Towers came down, because he wouldn't be allowed to give a speech.
occurrences.speaker: The New York Times
occurrences.subject: President Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: White House statement and 25th-anniversary 9/11 ceremony remarks or schedule
occurrences.quote_span: "President Trump has spoken about his own experiences watching the horrific events of September 11, 2001. On the 25th anniversary of this tragic day, the president will remember those who were killed at the hands of evil terrorists, honor their loved ones and pay tribute to the brave first responders who put their lives on the line to rescue their fellow Americans," White House principal deputy press secretary Anna Kelly said in a statement to Fox News.
occurrences.speaker: Anna Kelly
occurrences.subject: President Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Donald Trump's Truth Social post and the New York Times article
occurrences.quote_span: Trump lambasted the reporter behind the Times article, writing on Truth Social Friday that she "made up a story that on September 11th, I’m not going to the World Trade Center, in New York City, because they won’t let me make a speech, and I’m going to the Pentagon in D.C., because I’m a featured speaker.
occurrences.speaker: Donald Trump
occurrences.subject: President Donald Trump

occurrences.quote_span: This is more Corrupt News, I’ve been to New York many times over the years, and no one ever speaks, it’s a 'solemn ceremony!'" Trump said,
